$comment: YOUR BRAND — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. The engine (core/engine/remotion/src/bb2/engine.tsx) IMPORTS this file and derives its whole palette from it, so editing the 'colors' below re-skins EVERY scene automatically — no code edits. These are neutral placeholder colours: change them to yours (Claude can interview you). Keep every key present and a valid #rrggbb hex. 'Full creativity' is gated on this: creativity is in IDEAS + MOTION, never in inventing off-brand colours/type.

colors_doc.steel: the blue-grey the dark-UI ramp (panels/borders) derives toward — set near your base's hue
colors_doc.accent: your ONE brand colour (Marker word, plates, energy, CTAs)
colors_doc.accent_on_light: a darker on-light variant of the accent (the raw accent is usually unreadable on white)

accent_rule: ONE accent only. On a light surface the accent is a PLATE colour, never body text; on the accent plate use base (dark) ink. On dark, contrast is rule #1: ink (silver) or an accent plate, never dark-grey text.

fonts.$note: To change fonts, ALSO swap the 3 @remotion/google-fonts loader imports at the top of engine.tsx — a JSON value alone can't switch the font loader.

captions: white fill, heavy weight, dark outline + soft shadow, balanced wrap, no orphan words, synced to real word timings.
engine_palette_source: engine.tsx imports THIS file and derives all tokens — this file is authoritative.
